_comment: Krea 2 bake-off (N8, 2026-11-09): the style_v1 'painted cinematic' pictures (8 scenes + 2 portraits, same prompt text) on the Krea 2 checkpoint(s), with and without the Krea 2 LoRA, at BOTH sampler settings because a fine-tune's base (Turbo or Raw) is not in its name: turbo8 = 8 steps cfg 1.0, raw30 = 30 steps cfg 3.5 (the reference Raw setting is ~50 steps; 30 keeps the run near an hour). er_sde / simple. Needs qwen_image_vae.safetensors (pull_model.bat qwen-image-vae) and the Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder named in forge.json comfy.krea2. LICENCE: the Stable Yogi fine-tune says 'commercial use by permission only' in its own file — nothing it makes can ship unless William gets permission; the Krea 2 base models (Comfy-Org/Krea-2) are commercial-OK under US$1M/year revenue. NOT SUBMITTED by the session that wrote it.
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated neon, plastic skin, extra heads, duplicated figures
